sources.supports: Initiation compares non-young region capacity plus requested bytes to threshold; GC-cause requests are separate; request scheduling and actual concurrent-start pause are separate.
Predictor rows log heap()->used(), unlike the initiation check; fixed/adaptive threshold and percentage denominator behavior.
ExplicitGCInvokesConcurrent gates user-requested concurrent path; periodic/code-cache causes have their own routing.
Non-young capacity equals (old region count + humongous region count) * region size.
Concurrent request operation invokes force_concurrent_start_if_outside_cycle before collection.
